facts.text: One of the oldest members of the Galactic Republic, it was a planet full of lush life, and the planet's surface had not a touch of civilization on it.

evidence.quote: One of the oldest members of the Galactic Republic, it was a planet full of lush life, and the planet's surface had not a touch of civilization on it.

facts.text: The Ithorians themselves, otherwise known as "Hammerheads," built great floating cities that did not harm the surface, which they considered to be sacred.

evidence.quote: The Ithorians themselves, otherwise known as "Hammerheads," built great floating cities that did not harm the surface, which they considered to be sacred.

facts.text: Entry upon the surface was forbidden, unless one stayed there permanently.

evidence.quote: Entry upon the surface was forbidden, unless one stayed there permanently.

facts.text: Some Ithorians such as the Oracle were compelled to go down to the planet surface, however, as they "heard the call" of Mother Jungle, the Ithorian religion's personification of Ithor's world-spanning jungle.

evidence.quote: Some Ithorians such as the Oracle were compelled to go down to the planet surface, however, as they "heard the call" of Mother Jungle, the Ithorian religion's personification of Ithor's world-spanning jungle.

facts.text: The surface of the planet of Ithor played host to numerous plants, including the bafforr tree, which possessed telepathic capabilities.

facts.text: The planet had many moons in its night sky.

facts.text: Ithor joined the Galactic Republic prior to 8000 BBY.

facts.text: In 3963 BBY, when Republic fleet encountered a Mandalorian raiding force in an asteroid field near Ottega system, Dace Golliard predicted they would attack Ithor next, although it turned out to be a ruse set up by Zayne Carrick and Cassus Fett to capture Golliard.

evidence.quote: In 3963 BBY, when Republic fleet encountered a Mandalorian raiding force in an asteroid field near Ottega system, Dace Golliard predicted they would attack Ithor next, although it turned out to be a ruse set up by Zayne Carrick and Cassus Fett to capture Golliard.

facts.text: In 439 BBY, scientists attempted to bond the telepathic capabilities of the bafforr tree with another, more vicious tree on the planet surface.

facts.text: As in previous millennia, Ithor remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: The vast and well-protected natural resources of the forest world were never compromised by Separatist attacks.

evidence.quote: The vast and well-protected natural resources of the forest world were never compromised by Separatist attacks.

facts.text: A number of small attacks and probing actions were attempted against Ithor by the Confederacy early in the war, but these were determined to be little more than diversions as the Separatists launched full-scale invasions of Duro and other important Republic targets.

facts.text: Sometime before the Battle of Yavin, Ithor came under siege by the Galactic Empire, which demanded access to Ithorian agricultural techniques and technology in an attempt to locate biotech for military applications.

facts.text: Following the Ithorian belief in the Law of Life, most Ithorians never actually set foot on their own planet, instead they lived in floating cities above their world called herdships.
